title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: The answer must state the acceleration as 2 m/s², derived from a = μg.

title: Total time calculation
description: Essential: The answer for part (2) must give the correct total time of 2.5 s.

title: Shortest time and speed
description: Essential: The answer for part (3) must give the shortest time as 2 s and the corresponding minimum speed as 4 m/s.

title: Two-stage motion analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly separate the motion into an accelerated phase and a constant velocity phase.

title: Kinematics for accelerated phase
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the time and displacement for the object to reach the belt's initial speed.

title: Condition for shortest time
description: Important: The solution must recognize that the shortest time occurs when the object accelerates for the entire distance L.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All final numerical answers should include correct SI units (m/s, s, m/s²).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if friction force direction or acceleration sign is incorrectly assigned relative to motion.

title: Incorrect friction model
description: Pitfall: Penalize if static friction or a wrong coefficient is used to calculate the acceleration.

title: Misinterpreting shortest time condition
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the answer claims increasing belt speed always reduces the total time, without finding the optimum.
